title: memoforge gate answers
description: Result of gates.parse for any user gate; persisted as intake/followup-response.json and used for the AUQ plan gate (TZ v1.5 §2.4, §6).

action.description: Normalised keyword recognised by the single parser (TZ §2.4 rule (a)).

answers.description: Question key -> answer. Intake/follow-up keys are question ordinals ('1', '2'); the plan gate uses the AUQ question labels (Plan, Mode, Style, Sources).

defaults_applied.description: Keys answered by defaults rather than by the user.

generation.description: Gate channel generation; 0 = AUQ, incremented on text-fallback (TZ §2.4).
